name: Silhouette system
body:
# Silhouette system

Silhouettes are Lantern's prefabs: a named type with preset values, stored as a folder of Calamus files, able to `@base` another Silhouette and to hold children that can be Silhouettes themselves. A scene instance names its Silhouette and stores only `*` overrides. Design: fearless-hq `projects/umbra-game-engine/silhouette-system.md` (Dean's decisions of 2026-11-05).

Slices: a C API over Amanuensis's Calamus reader and writer linked into lantern-native; a `lantern:::silhouette` Nox library that loads a Silhouette folder, resolves chains and instances and reports cycles and missing Silhouettes; game Silhouettes and tests; editor palette integration after that.
